title.narrative: Supporting Viet Nam to roll out the 2021 Recommendation on the Ethics of AI and the 2017 Declaration on Ethical Principles in relation to Climate Change

description.narrative: In line with the Position Paper for the Social and Human Sciences in Southeast Asia, developed in 2023 by the Bangkok Office, this workstream builds on UNESCO's recently adopted Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence through promoting increased awareness and understanding as well as active use of the Recommendation. More specifically, the workplan will consist in deploying the AI Ethics Readiness Assessment methodology (RAM) in Vietnam, in partnership with the concerned national institutions and in coordination with the other RAMs in the region, and in complement of the EU INTPA project (where Vietnam is one of the beneficiary countries). This process should include capacity-building activities, policy dialogue, as well as synergies with CI (MIL) and partnership building for resource mobilisation.
